title: NPDev External AI Verdict
description: The structured response ingested from an external AI (ADR-0009). recordKind is fixed to the literal 'external-ai-verdict' precisely so it can never be confused with, or laundered into, 'independent-human-review' or a sign-off in any ledger, knowledge card, or generated artefact -- the honesty contract's rule 1, enforced structurally rather than left to prose convention.

recordKind.description: Always this literal. Never 'independent-human-review', never 'sign-off' -- see ADR-0009 honesty rule 1.

packManifestSha256.description: Ties this verdict to the exact external-ai-pack it was rendered against -- provenance that never launders an AI answer detached from what it actually saw.

vendor.description: e.g. 'anthropic', 'openai' -- the vendor identity, recorded verbatim in the status string per ADR-0009.

model.description: e.g. 'claude-opus-5' -- the specific model, not just the vendor.

receivedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the verdict was ingested.

noRepoAccess.description: Structural assertion of ADR-0009's hard invariant: this model had no filesystem, repo, shell, or network access to the host. Always true; a verdict record where this could be false should never exist.

autoApplied.description: Structural assertion of honesty rule 5: findings are filed, never auto-applied. Always false.

isCalibration.description: True when this verdict is a P4 calibration run (M0-CALIB-*), scored found/missed/hallucinated rather than filed as a live finding.

calibrationScore.description: Present when isCalibration is true, or when a non-calibration mission's 'no findings' result must travel with the channel's known yield (honesty rule 4).

note.description: e.g. 'channel recorded low-yield -- found neither known bug'.

findings.description: May be empty -- an empty array is a 'no findings' result, which per honesty rule 4 is only meaningful alongside a calibrationScore.

claim.description: The reviewer's claim, verbatim or lightly cleaned -- never rewritten to sound more confirmed than stated.

evidenceChunkIds.description: Which pack chunks the claim references, so a human can locate and attempt local reproduction.

shown.description: Restates the pack's shown[] at ingestion time -- what this specific verdict was rendered against.

notShown.description: Restates the pack's notShown[] -- the declared limitation travels with the verdict, not just the pack.
